visualCharacteristics.purpose: homepage hero photo with heading, intro and an inline car search form (country, model, location, results CTA, expand-search toggle)

contentPattern.structure: image | text (heading, paragraph) | model placeholder | location placeholder | CTA link (results page URL + label) | countries (comma-separated, optional) | expand-search label (optional)

reuseGuidance: Use once on the homepage as the search entry point. For a hero without a form use hero-banner.
